retained.name: log-reader
retained.justification: Labels prove Docker Desktop extension ownership: com.docker.desktop.extension=true, com.docker.compose.project=drone_drone-ci-docker-extension-desktop-extension, service `log-reader`. An idle log tailer (command `tail -f /dev/null`, read-only bind on the extension's data volume), created 2026-07-26, restart=always, publishes no host port. Docker Desktop manages the extension lifecycle, so a bare `docker rm` fights the manager; if the container is unwanted, uninstall the Drone CI extension in Docker Desktop instead.

proposed_removals.name: nervous_dhawan
proposed_removals.reason: Labels docker-mcp=true, docker-mcp-name=mongodb: an accumulated Docker MCP Toolkit server instance (MongoDB MCP Server, stdio transport). docs/guides/docker-and-mcp.md section 2 documents exactly this accumulation and sanctions cleaning with `docker ps -q --filter label=docker-mcp=true | xargs -r docker rm -f`. Stateless by construction: no volumes, no published ports, restart=no; the gateway recreates a server container on demand. Created 2026-07-31; removal loses nothing.
